PostingDate.name: Posting Date
PostingDate.definition: Date/time of the posting (credit or debit) to the account.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date/time when calculating economic benefit for a cash amount.

ForeignExchangeRateFixingDate.name: Foreign Exchange Rate Fixing Date
ForeignExchangeRateFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which a foreign exchange rate will be determined.

EarliestPaymentDate.name: Earliest Payment Date
EarliestPaymentDate.definition: Date/time on which a payment can be made, for example, if the payment date is a non-business day or to indicate the first payment date of an offer.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date on which the distribution is due to take place (cash and/or securities).
